main_text.p: tribunalibus omnibus appellatio est ad conventus juridicos, aut Cameram Hovetmannorum Groningensium, de quibus post nobis erit dicendi locus. Olim autem non Hovetmanni solùm, sed etiam Consules senatusq; Groninganus plerisq; in causis appellati sunt, interponendiq; edicta ac mandata tum suo tum Ordinum agrariorum nomine potestatem habuerunt, causasq; ipsas unà cum cæteris in conventibus juridicis recognovêre & definivêre, ut ex iis, quæ infrà de jure civitatis dicentur, fiet manifestum. Sed Ober: recht; & aliud quondam tribunal in agro fuit, & adhuc est, ad crimina graviora, quæ capitalia putantur, controversiasq; de jurisdictionibus cognoscendas & judicandas pertinens, quod vocant communiter Dat Ouerrecht: quod vicos complures ejusdem vicinæ collegit, è quibus ii, qui eo jure præditi sunt, (id similiter ut prius prædiis certis cohærent) vertente anno coëunt certo loco, ubi antiquitus tribunal hoc locatum fuit, & in leges ac incorruptam justitiæ administrationem juramento obstringunt sese, ad quos vi-

page.notes: Marginal note on the right is in black letter ("Ober:" / "recht;"). The catchword at the bottom right is hard to read and is given as "cos" with a doubt. The printed "s" forms are rendered as plain s, and u/v and i/j are normalised. The ligature "æ" and abbreviations such as "q;" and "&" are kept as printed. The word "Ouerrecht" is printed in black letter in the main text. The bottom-right catchword may be partly obscured by a mark, so please check it against the scan.
